purpose: Independent practice of blending CVC words.
student_learning_goal: I can blend sounds to decode CVC words.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can blend sounds to decode CVC words.
header.character_watermark: Sounder Sam and Blendy together in the top-right with a sound-blending strip showing letters sliding together. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 words, sound each letter and SLIDE the sounds together. Read the word.
parts.visual_layout: Four sound-box rows, each with three letters already placed and a slide arrow underneath pointing left to right.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 sound-and-slide layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 4 sound-box rows with letters already filled: c-a-t, m-a-p, s-u-n, l-i-d. Each row has a slide arrow underneath pointing left to right with dots showing the slide motion.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_SLIDE at Part 1: keywords name the letters in sound boxes and the slide arrow gesture.

parts.student_instructions: Read each word. Draw a line to its picture.
parts.visual_layout: Four sound-box words on the left and four picture choices on the right with connecting space for match lines.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 word-to-picture match layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. Left column: 4 sound-box words (DOG, PIN, CUP, BAG). Right column: 4 picture icons. Space between for student to draw match lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_MATCH at Part 2: keywords name the word and picture match task across two columns.

parts.student_instructions: Read 2 NEW words and write each one on the line.
parts.visual_layout: Two sound-box words with empty writing lines below for the child to write the word they read.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 new-word read layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 2 sound-box words (FOX, JET) with letters filled. Below each: an empty handwriting line ~3in long for the child to write the word.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_NEW at Part 3: keywords name the new-word read and write task with handwriting lines.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, build and read one MORE new CVC word in your sound box.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — confirm child blends smoothly and can transfer to a new (Part 3) word.
